authority: User measurements supersede catalog candidates and previous CAD assumptions for the measured envelope only.
transcription_note: Measurements were relayed by the primary agent from the current conversation. Descriptions below preserve ambiguities; they are summaries, not invented verbatim user quotations.

provenance_definitions.user_measured: Dimension reported by the user from the physical component; independent measurement by the agent is not claimed.
provenance_definitions.user_reported_hardware: Available hardware or preferred nominal size reported by the user.
provenance_definitions.user_requirement: Requested design behavior, not a measured dimension.
provenance_definitions.source_geometry: Coordinate retained from original CAD; not a new physical user measurement.
provenance_definitions.derived: Arithmetic from explicitly identified inputs; not independently measured.
provenance_definitions.unconfirmed: Not supplied, ambiguous, or inconsistent. Do not substitute a previous catalog assumption.
provenance_definitions.design_choice: CAD design choice made for this iteration, not a physical dimension measured by the user.
provenance_definitions.cad_validation: Numerical CAD/mesh clearance result reported during this iteration; not a physical user measurement.

wall_slot_gap_mm.note: Gap/slot that receives the printed enclosure wall; do not interpret as neck diameter.

cross_section_shape.note: Only width and height of the neck are confirmed; corner profile/radius is unspecified.

fit_clearance_mm.note: Printing clearance must be added deliberately; it is not included in the measured neck dimensions.

motor_cable_boot.description: Neck 8.5 wide by 10.5 high; wall slot 2.5; opening must reach the lid seam and remain open upward.

total_unpressed_height_mm.note: Total height in the unpressed state, not the height of the switch body alone.

body_height_mm.note: Not supplied; do not equate it with the 5 mm total unpressed height.

tactile_button.description: Tactile 12 by 12, total unpressed height 5. Body height was not provided.

module_total_depth_mm.note: Reported total depth; PCB laminate thickness alone is not established.

pcb_laminate_thickness_mm.note: Do not use the 3.5 mm total module depth as PCB thickness.

visible_window_width_mm.note: Preserve this requested window while resolving the margin discrepancy.

visible_window_height_mm.note: Preserve this requested window while resolving the margin discrepancy.

bottom_margin_to_visible_area_mm.note: Reported bottom-to-visible-area margin; datum/axis needs confirmation.

top_margin_to_visible_area_mm.note: Approximate reported top margin, not an exact value.

margin_sum_with_window_height_mm.note: 9 + approximately 7 + 14.5; exceeds the reported 28 mm PCB height.

connected_dupont_extent_mm.note: 15 mm normal to the PCB, rearward to the outside of connected Dupont plastic; cable bend excluded. Axis clarified by the user.

dupont_extent_axis_and_edge.note: The 15 mm dimension is rearward along the PCB normal, not an in-plane extension. Specific header XY position is not supplied.

dupont_cable_bend_envelope_mm.note: Excluded from the reported 15 mm and not supplied.

exact_module_sku.note: Measured envelope does not identify controller or vendor.

oled_module.description: PCB 27.5 by 28; total depth 3.5. Connected Dupont adds 15 mm rearward NORMAL to the PCB, excluding cable bend. Bottom margin 9 and top about 7 still conflict with the 28 mm board height and 27 by 14.5 window.

connected_dupont_extension_beyond_pcb_ed.note: 11.5 mm beyond the PCB edge, in the PCB plane along its 26 mm direction, through the 90-degree Dupont connector.

dupont_edge_and_direction.note: User clarified the right-angle (90-degree) Dupont extends along the long PCB direction; it is not a normal-to-PCB depth.

dupont_cable_bend_envelope_mm.note: Not supplied; do not treat the connector plastic extension as the complete cable envelope.

shaft_axis_from_nonconnector_end_mm.note: Measured along the 26 mm direction, from the end without the connector.

shaft_axis_from_connector_end_mm.note: 26 - 10.5, assuming the connector end is opposite the reported nonconnector end.

shaft_axis_transverse_margin_a_mm.note: Approximate; physical side A has not been identified in CAD.

shaft_axis_transverse_margin_b_mm.note: Approximate; physical side B has not been identified in CAD.

transverse_margin_sum_mm.note: Approximately 8 + approximately 10; differs from the reported 18.5 mm PCB width by 0.5 mm.

transverse_side_orientation.note: Do not silently center the shaft or choose which edge is 8 mm.

body_height_and_terminal_keepout_mm.note: Bare encoder body height alone is not isolated; installed flat PCB plane 6.2 mm and deepest solder tip 8 mm are confirmed separately, giving 1.8 mm solder protrusion.

encoder_module.description: PCB 26 by 18.5; 90-degree Dupont adds 11.5 in-plane along the 26 mm direction. Shaft 10.5 from the nonconnector end; transverse about 8 and about 10 without side identification. Flat PCB/contact plane is 6.2 mm from the inner enclosure face and deepest solder tip is 8 mm from that same face, giving 1.8 mm solder protrusion.

dupont_connector_angle_degrees.note: Right-angle connector as clarified by the user.

assembly_depth_from_inner_case_face_to_d.note: Measured from the INNER enclosure face to the deepest solder tip; not the thickness of the bare PCB or distance from its bare face.

pcb_bare_face_contact_offset_from_inner_.note: User confirmed the flat PCB/contact plane is 6.2 mm from the inner enclosure face.

solder_protrusion_beyond_flat_pcb_face_m.note: 8.0 mm deepest solder tip minus 6.2 mm flat PCB plane, both measured from the same inner case face; replaces the former unmeasured 0.6 mm relief.

preferred_nominal_length_mm.note: Preferred option, not a derived engagement calculation.

insert_outer_diameter_mm.note: Not supplied by the user; existing pilot/boss defaults are not measurements.

insert_length_mm.note: Not supplied by the user; no validated screw/insert engagement calculation yet.

reported_length_mm.note: Length reference (total or under-head) was not specified.

wood_thickness_mm.note: Not supplied; safe screw penetration/engagement cannot be derived.

original_hole_centers_mm.note: Original X/Y centres; do not relocate them based on the screw-head measurement.

original_center_spacing_mm.note: 83 - (-83), from original CAD centres; not newly measured by the user.

count.note: Exactly two assemblies. ESP32 and relays share the same protoboard assembly.

reported_height_mm.note: Maximum total assembly height, including solder.

solder_and_terminal_keepouts_mm.note: Solder is included in the measured overall 17 mm height; separate terminal, wire insertion and cable-bend envelopes are not supplied.

reported_maximum_height_mm.note: Maximum total assembly height is 21 mm at the relay, including solder; keep the complete lower solder/wire-wrap envelope in the assembly datum.

lowest_point_definition.value: Assembly includes underside solder and wire-wrap

usb_socket_height_mm.note: Socket height does not establish plug overmold or insertion corridor.

usb_reported_height_above_lowest_assembl.note: Approximate. The reference lowest point includes solder/wire-wrap; user did not say whether 18 denotes socket centre or bottom.

usb_height_targets_socket_center_or_bott.note: Do not silently choose a centre/bottom datum or derive the cutout centre.

superseded_assumptions.replacement: Measured PCB 27.5 by 28 mm; total module depth 3.5 mm.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: Mount full encoder module using bare EC11 body envelope
superseded_assumptions.replacement: Measured encoder PCB 26 by 18.5 mm and connector extension 11.5 mm; bare body depth is still unconfirmed.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: Three independently mounted boards: ESP32, relays and supply
superseded_assumptions.replacement: Two assemblies: 100 by 50 ESP32+relay protoboard, and 54 by 24 supply.

superseded_assumptions.assumption: Infer insert OD/length, button body height or USB centre from nominal hardware
superseded_assumptions.replacement: Keep these quantities unconfirmed until their specific datum/dimension is supplied.

rearward_case_extension_mm.note: 25 mm rearward extension chosen to clear measured boards and OLED Dupont plus the configured wire bend. The earlier 20 mm candidate had a reported 68.1 mm3 envelope overlap; this is a design choice, not a user-measured dimension.

preserve_front_control_positions.note: Extend rearward while retaining the front controls at their original positions.

preserve_original_desk_hole_centres.note: Keep the original source centres X=0,Y=-83 and X=0,Y=83; do not move them with the rearward extension.

rejected_20mm_candidate_overlap_mm3.note: Reported overlap between a board maximum envelope and the OLED connector/wire-bend envelope at the 20 mm extension; the extension was increased to 25 mm.

expected_rear_routing_gap_mm.note: Approximate design estimate for the 25 mm extension, not a physical measurement or a certified minimum surface-distance bound.
